headline: Approved moving three holiday meetings to Tuesdays and accepted the work plan.
summary: Chairman Goodman led a discussion of data reports and a list of possible missing data sources. The list includes 211 referrals, Fire/EMS data, and hospital data.
decisions: Approved moving the 11/26, 12/24, and 12/31 meetings to Tuesdays, with other meetings held Thursdays at 1:00 p.m.

plain_text:
HOMELESS SERVICES GAP ANALYSIS COMMITTEE 
 
  NOVEMBER 5, 2026 
 
A meeting of the Homeless Services Gap Analysis Committee was held Thursday, November 5, 2026 at 1:02 p.m. in 
the Aldermanic Chamber and duly noticed in two places, including the City’s website, in accordance with the 
requirements of RSA 91-A:2 II. 
 
Let’s start the meeting by taking a roll call attendance.   
 
The roll call was taken with 7 members of the Homeless Services Gap Analysis Committee present:   
 
Chairman Goodman presided. 
 
Members of the Committee present: Alderman-at-Large Alicia Gregg, Clerk 
 Alderman Thomas Lopez (arrived at 1:10 p.m.) 
 LaTonya Muccioli (arrived at 1:09 p.m.) 
 Megan Caron 
 Bobbie Bagley, Public Health Director (via Zoom) 
 Tonia Knisley, Vice-Chairman 
 Jane Goodman, Chairman 
  
Members of the Committee absent:  
 
Also in Attendance:  
             
 
ROLL CALL 
  
MEETING DATES  
 
1. Housekeeping, moving the following meetings due to holidays to Tuesday at 1 PM  
a. 11/26 to 11/24 
b. 12/24 to 12/22 
c. 12/31 to 12/29 
MOTION BY ALDERMAN GREGG TO ACCEPT THE SCHEDULED MEETING DATES TO BE HELD IN THE 
ALDERMANIC CHAMBER.  EXCEPT AS STATED, ALL OTHER MEETINGS WILL TAKE PLACE EVERY 
THURSDAY AT 1:00 P.M. IN THE ALDERMANIC CHAMBER 
MOTION CARRIED 
 
DATA REPORTS 
 
Chairman Goodman discussed data reports.
